summary: This document pertains to the maintenance of program profile invoice rates. It includes functionalities for managing invoice contact information, setting up invoice details, and processing user interactions within the invoice rate interface.
purpose: The purpose of the document is to facilitate the management and modification of invoice rates associated with program profiles, integrating user session data and handling specific user interface commands.

workflows.name: Invoice Rate Management
steps: Page load with session check and setup.
Select, insert, update, and delete operations using ObjectDataSource with relevant session data.
Handling of commands for adding, editing, or deleting invoice rates.
Pre-rendering for user interface adjustments based on editability.

business_rules: Screen is editable based on user session data.
Invoice rates modifications are subject to user permissions.
validations: Validation of currency format for rate entries.
Session data validation for ensuring operations are bound to a user context.
conditions: Check if user session is active before performing operations.
Ensure screen is editable for performing add/edit operations.
system_behavior: User sessions are cached to maintain continuity across operations.
Redirect behavior for save and cancel events.
dependencies: Grid utilities for handling data operations.
